relations.statement: For distinct role tags k and k', no implicit coercion Witness_k[P] to Witness_k'[P] exists; conversion only via a declared adapter with hypotheses (WDP-CH02-P01).
relations.hypotheses: nominal typed interface; tags k distinct

relations.statement: On the oriented triangle, the circulation functional l vanishes on im d0 and l(1,1,1)=3, so it is a dual certificate.
relations.hypotheses: oriented triangle cochain complex; l = sum of edge values around the cycle

lemmas.statement: With nominal tags, the seven role types are pairwise distinct types; there is no coercion between them without an adapter.

near_misses.claim: A dual certificate witness is an observer or retention witness because l(1,1,1)=3 is nonzero.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Nominal role tags do not coerce without an adapter, and the certificate observes, retains and decides nothing.

near_misses.claim: A residual locus witness is a memory, agent or apparatus.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The locus is a witness to a proposition, defined by nonzero residual component at L under the declared test.
